messages:
Tori (CS): FYI — HarborLink seat pings and API calls down ~55% over the last 10d. New procurement lead Amir Khan started this week; CTO mentioned a short bake-off with DeepServe. Renewal ~28 days. Can we triage?

Noah (Infra): Pulling logs now. Any 4xx/5xx spikes? Looping in @Priya.

Priya (Solutions): Seeing clustered 401/429 for org_id=99011 on 2025-08-04. Snippets: `{"org":99011,"status":401,"err":"invalid_token"}` then `{"status":429,"err":"rate_limit"}`. Likely token rotation + job retry storms.

Evan (Sales): If CTO is testing DeepServe, we need quick wins: (1) restore their traffic ASAP, (2) offer a short perf window to stall vendor momentum. I'll draft commercial language.

Tori (CS): Proposed immediate plan:
- Outreach: quick async note to Amir offering 30m triage today (Priya + Noah).
- Tech: confirm token in env vs console; Noah to rotate token and bump rate-limit window temporarily.
- Commercial: offer a 10-day complimentary dedicated perf window + telemetry review; Evan to prep terms.
- CRM: tag reasons ["seat_drop","procurement_change","competitive_eval"] and mark renewal_flag=at-risk until follow-up.

Support Bot: Ticket HL-3001 created  "HarborLink: invalid_token + rate_limit; renewal-risk" https://support.redwood/HL-3001

Priya (Solutions): Sending Amir a short checklist now: (a) confirm API token matches console, (b) upgrade SDK >=1.5.1, (c) run sample request & paste response.

Noah (Infra): I can rotate token and re-run webhook deliveries. ETA ~20m. Will also add temporary rate-limit increase for trial.

Evan (Sales): I'll prepare trial PO: "10-day dedicated perf window, SLA 99.9%, complimentary credits" and route to Legal for fast-track.

Tori (CS): Thanks all  please update this thread when HL-3001 is resolved and when the trial is scheduled. I'll prepare an exec one-pager for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
